capabilities: Ingest web clippings by merging new material into existing wiki pages with LLM-generated WikiLinks
Answer questions in a chat panel using local index retrieval of the top 5 relevant wiki pages with source citations
Save chat insights as permanent wiki pages with de-conversationalized text, aliases, and summaries
Audit the wiki for contradictions, orphan files, and stale placeholder pages
Customize LLM prompts by editing skill files like Ingest.md, Query.md, Lint.md, and SavePage.md
extras: Install is manual only (copying release files into .obsidian/plugins/); Obsidian staff have not reviewed the plugin; the JSON index design targets iOS sandbox limits and sync via iCloud, Git, or Obsidian Sync.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin inspired by Andrej Karpathy's "LLM Wiki" concept
motivation: The author wanted to solve the limitations of traditional RAG systems, where search is ephemeral and knowledge doesn't compound.
problem: Traditional RAG search is ephemeral, so retrieved answers don't build up into a persistent, compounding knowledge base inside the vault.

requires.name: LLM provider API key (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, or OpenRouter)

summary: LLM-driven knowledge base that ingests web clippings into linked wiki pages, answers questions with citations, and audits the wiki for conflicts.
